slots.name: championship game revenue
slots.sentence: And, don't forget about the money made from the game itself, which grosses around $100 million for the conference, with a television deal with ESPN included.

slots.name: proposed playoff size
slots.sentence: Coming out of their meetings this week at Big Ten headquarters, the College Football Playoff committee is now formally waiting to see what ESPN is willing to offer for an expansion from 12 teams to 24.

slots.name: negotiation window duration
slots.sentence: Right now, with the 30-day negotiating window coming to a close over the next week, ESPN is putting together an offer the network hopes will suffice those who are making the decisions on whether or not to expand the playoff.
